messages:
alex: seeing spikes of apiserver 5xx in eu-west1 since ~08:10, controller-manager leader churn and GPU attach backlog. KV cache miss rate jumps at the same time. logs attached below

maria-sre: +1, saw the same. apiserver latency up to 800ms then 503s. controller-manager keep failing to list pods. suspect proxy connection resets between apiserver and etcd/provisioner.

sam: any recent network/deploy changes in eu-west1?

deploy-bot: deployment red-proxy v2.4.1 rolled out to eu-west1 at 08:05 by jen (sha: a1b2c3).

jen: that rollout changed the TCP keepalive settings and bumped proxy worker threads. rolling back now.

alex: logs show a lot of kvcache "stomp" events: one writer evicting others, and then apiserver retries. snippet:
```
E1008 08:10:47.123 apiserver handler.go:200] kvcache: key stomp detected: resource=pods namespace=prod
W1008 08:10:47.456 proxy.go:87] connection reset by peer from 10.12.34.8:443
```

maria-sre: also seeing high SYN_RECV and conntrack drops on the NAT. `conntrack -S` shows ephemeral exhaustion spikes.

oncall: mitigation path: 1) scale apiserver from 3->5 replicas 2) evict newest proxy rollout 3) increase conntrack max and tune nf_conntrack_tcp_timeout_close_wait for a short window. I'll take steps 1 and 2 now.

sam: if apiserver latency stays high we should pin controller-manager to older leader probe intervals to stop tight list loops. Suggest changing `--leader-elect-resource-lock` config to reduce thrash while we stabilize.

lisa: heads up — GPU attach backlog is causing ~200 idle GPUs waiting for pods in eu-west1, finance asked for estimate of extra cost this incident. Can someone capture minutes?

alex: noted. rough calc: ~200 GPUs * 0.08 $/min * 60 = ~960 $/hr while backlog persists. will confirm after we know how long.

jen: rollback complete, proxy v2.4.0 now serving in eu-west1. monitoring for 3 minutes.

maria-sre: conntrack counts falling, apiserver 503s dropping to 0, kvcache miss rate trending back down. controller-manager leader stable.

oncall: scaled apiserver to 5 and increased conntrack max to 262144 on all eu-west1 NATs. applied keepalive revert.

sam: added a temporary controller-manager config tweak to lengthen resync (will revert in 24h).

alex: action items: 1) follow up postmortem (jen) 2) add proxy rollout preflight tests for conntrack pressure (maria-sre) 3) run a stress test in staging to validate keepalive bump (sam) 4) estimate cost impact and notify finance (lisa). I'll open an incident and assign.

lisa: thanks — pls tag me in incident and send estimate when available.

jen: creating incident INC-2023-482 and m1 doc. adding notes and timeline.

alex: nice work team. closing thread once incident doc has initial estimates and pager duty postmortem link. :thumbsup:
